package backuptarget

// Excerpt of openweft/weft-block v0.2.0 (pkg/backuptarget/sftp.go:53-55,
// pkg/types/types.go:23-29): the env name is a const, read elsewhere through
// os.Getenv(envSFTPPassword).

import "os"

const (
	envSFTPPassword      = "WEFT_SFTP_PASSWORD"
	envSFTPKeyFile       = "WEFT_SFTP_KEY_FILE"
	envSFTPKeyPassphrase = "WEFT_SFTP_KEY_PASSPHRASE"
	envSFTPKnownHosts    = "WEFT_SFTP_KNOWN_HOSTS"
	AWSAccessKeyID       = "AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID"
	AWSSecretKey         = "AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"
	AWSSessionToken      = "AWS_SESSION_TOKEN"
	CIFSPassword         = "CIFS_PASSWORD"
	StatusTokenExpired   = "TOKEN_EXPIRED"
	MaxTokens            = "MAX_TOKENS"
)

func auth() string { return os.Getenv(envSFTPPassword) }
